source: Descriptions of the connected DatoCMS get_api_methods, whoami, and upsert_and_execute_safe_script tools
scriptFormat: TypeScript ESM with top-level await and console.log
whoami: Authenticated account email, name and company; it does not promise project write permissions.
verification: A method token from get_api_methods is required for every distinct client resource/method call.
readOnly: The safe execution tool uses a read-only token and blocks mutations.
noExecute: Stores the script without executing it.
nodeRuntime: The inspected remote-mcp source at 35a24a5 executes in Node with Node types and does not ban builtin imports. The bounded fixture supports structuredClone for JSON values and node:util isDeepStrictEqual for JSON value comparison; it does not expose filesystem or network builtins.
limitations: The fixture runs real installed SDK/helper type declarations and pure helper code, but simulates authentication, records, transport and verification tokens. It is not a hosted OAuth test. Historical fixture results used a different runtime contract.
